name: Microsoft Lists
description: Microsoft Lists is a Microsoft 365 product for tracking structured information and team processes. People use it to organize records, coordinate work, monitor status, and collaborate through customizable lists and views.
agentUseSummary: Connect one administrator-granted Microsoft List through Relay-owned work-account OAuth with delegated Lists.SelectedOperations.Selected, then let agents inspect bounded list, approved-column, and approved-field item metadata through four fixed Graph wrappers. Relay excludes other sites and lists, unapproved fields, attachments and drive content, identities and permissions, writes, delta, search, subscriptions, exports, application access, arbitrary OData, pagination, beta APIs, and raw Graph access.

capabilities.label: Read selected list metadata
capabilities.description: Review one administrator-granted list and its approved columns.

capabilities.label: Read approved list fields
capabilities.description: Review bounded items containing only explicitly approved fields.

allowed.label: Read selected list metadata
allowed.description: Read bounded metadata for the connection-bound administrator-granted Microsoft List.

allowed.label: List approved columns
allowed.description: List bounded column metadata only for connection-approved field names.

allowed.label: List approved-field items
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five selected-list items containing only connection-approved fields.

allowed.label: Read approved-field item
allowed.description: Read one explicit prior-result item containing only connection-approved fields.

blocked.label: Access other lists or sites
blocked.description: Discovery or access outside the one connection-bound administrator-granted list is outside V1.

blocked.label: Read unapproved fields or content
blocked.description: Unapproved, hidden, system, person, lookup, and location fields plus attachments, drive content, previews, thumbnails, and versions are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access identities or permissions
blocked.description: Users, groups, created-by and modified-by identities, permissions, sharing, and analytics are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change, synchronize, or use raw Lists access
blocked.description: Writes, administration, delta, search, subscriptions, exports, application permissions, arbitrary OData, automatic pagination, beta APIs, and raw Graph access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four selected-list delegated reads run automatically; other resources, unapproved content, identities, permissions, writes, synchronization, application access, pagination, beta, and raw Graph remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four selected-list reads run without Relay per-action approval; the administrator grant, approved fields, limits, audit, redaction, and Microsoft controls still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four selected-list approved-field read wrappers and attaches encrypted Microsoft tokens only on Railway.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay still needs its Entra application registration, delegated Lists.SelectedOperations.Selected configuration and admin consent, an explicit read grant on one staging list, the exact Railway callback, staging credentials, a work account, safe approved field names, and Microsoft acceptance. Those provider-console, grant, and live-consent actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the Relay-owned Entra application and exact callback, admin-consent the delegated selected-list scope, grant read access to one staging list, store credentials on Railway staging, then verify work-account consent, exact scope, PKCE/state, refresh rotation, selected-list binding, approved-field filtering, all four reads, throttling, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Microsoft Graph delegated authorization uses the v2 authorization-code flow, supports PKCE, and uses offline_access when a refresh token is required.
Delegated Lists.SelectedOperations.Selected is admin-consented and limits access to lists explicitly permissioned to the application on behalf of a signed-in user.
Microsoft Graph provides a fixed selected-site list metadata endpoint for work or school accounts.
Microsoft Graph provides a list-scoped column-definition collection endpoint.
Microsoft Graph provides a list-scoped item collection endpoint and supports expanding selected field values.
Microsoft Graph provides an exact list-item read and supports selecting explicit field values.
